![Settings.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/experiments/image/settings-d8ac17726022.svg) [**Settings**](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open) \> **Experiments** let you enable and disable experimental features of Chrome DevTools.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Caution:** Chrome DevTools experiments may be unstable.

To enable an experiment:

1. [Open Settings](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/settings#open).
2. In the **Experiments** tab, search for the experiment you would like to try in the **Filter** textbox.
3. Enable the ![Checkbox.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/experiments/image/checkbox-19aa473fcaa1f.svg) checkbox next to the experiment.
4. Close ![Settings.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/experiments/image/settings-c918a263a8f53.svg) **Settings**.
5. If required, click **Reload DevTools** in the prompt at the top.

The next time you open DevTools, the experiment is enabled. To disable an experiment, clear the corresponding checkbox.

![The Experiments tab.](https://developer.chrome.com/static/docs/devtools/settings/experiments/image/the-experiments-tab-8640e1825d833.png)
